notes.title: Red Embrace: New BL Game Release!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29096909/d3a2251dc3fbdcdba64f1b4a65d626f24ca9fdae.jpg

We've just released a new BL game on  Steam, Itch, and Google Play!

For those of you who haven't heard, we launched our latest yaoi project, Red Embrace, on various platforms yesterday! 

It's a vampire-themed romance/drama VN set in modern day San Francisco. If you're interested, make sure to check it out! See the summary and features below!

----

Summary:

The graveyard shift at a dingy diner in San Francisco – that’s where MC’s story begins.  It’s just another normal night, or at least it seems to be. 

…That is, until a certain mysterious customer stops by, bringing the dangerous attention of a few people with him. When it rains, it pours, and suddenly MC finds himself in the middle of a war he didn’t even know existed… between vampires.

How does MC react to the dark, violent world that opens up before him? That’s up to you!

Features:

► Genre: Drama, BxB romance, dark modern
► Length: ~45,000 words
► Endings: 6 

► Changeable MC personality & interests
► Different dialogue & choices based on personality
► 11 track OST with a dark, urban vibe
► 10 CGs

-----

Thanks again for your support!

Follow us on Twitter for regular updates, join our community on Discord to chat with fellow yaoi fans, and support us on Patreon for extras and bonuses!

notes.title: New BL Game Release!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/mz6BhAJ.jpg

Our new BL game, Chess of Blades, is now on Steam (22% off!)!

Hello dear Req fans,

For those of you who haven't heard yet, Argent Games' latest BL visual novel Chess of Blades recently launched on Steam! It's also currently at 22% off!

CoB features full voice acting and is the same length as Requiescence (125,000 words), with an R-18 patch available on our Itch.io page. If you enjoyed Requiescence and you're interested in checking out our latest work, give CoB a try!

If you want to keep up with our current BL projects, come chat with the devs/fellow yaoi fans on Discord, follow us on Twitter, or check out our Tumblr blog!

Thank you all for your support, and happy gaming!
